name: Iwamizawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Iwamizawa city emblem in yellow: a lozenge of arrows pointing outward from a central cross.
history: Municipal flag of Iwamizawa, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 22 June 1968; the emblem dates from 1 April 1948.

features.role: Iwamizawa city emblem — a lozenge of arrows pointing outward from a central cross
